name: unannotated await fetch is a Response
source: import * as http from 'node:http'; async function main(): Promise<void> { const srv = http.createServer((req, res) => { res.statusCode = 201; res.end('hi'); }); await new Promise<void>((r) => srv.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => r())); const port = (srv.address() as any).port; const r = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:' + port + '/'); console.log(r.status, r.ok); console.log(await r.text()); srv.close(); }
